Package models.academic

Class Mark

java.lang.Object
models.academic.Mark
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Mark>
public class Mark extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<Mark>
Represents the mark (grade) for a student in a specific course. A mark consists of three components: 1st attestation, 2nd attestation, and final exam. Students cannot fail a course more than 3 times total.
